name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and configures Nginx for three static HTTPS virtual hosts, including site content, TLS, security headers, Fail2ban, firewall rules, SSH hardening, and kernel hardening.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis, including Redis authentication, service enablement, log-directory setup, and post-generation configuration adjustments.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Installs Python and PostgreSQL, deploys the FastAPI tutorial application, creates its database and virtual environment, writes environment configuration, and manages its Uvicorn systemd service.
